description: This file defines the TasksRepository class which acts as a data access layer for TaskEntity objects, providing methods to observe, retrieve, insert, update, and delete tasks via a TaskDao.

classes.name: TasksRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data operations for TaskEntity objects.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the list of all TaskEntity objects, observing changes.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Fetches a specific TaskEntity by its ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new TaskEntity into the data source and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of TaskEntity objects.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of TaskEntity objects into the data source.
